Annieville is the north-west North Delta neighbourhood on the Fraser River frontage in the City of Delta, with River Road as its frontage street and 116 Street at its east side.
The City publishes no street-by-street written boundary for Annieville; the mapped boundary comes from the former North Delta Area Plan.
Nordel sits east and south-east, the Tilbury industrial lands run west along River Road, and the Fraser River closes the north side.
The stock is predominantly single detached houses, with duplex product appearing through rezonings on the River Road side.

Lot sizes split sharply by zone: river-side RD3 (Duplex/Single Detached Residential 3) and RS1 lots carry 4,000 square metre minimums, while an RS6 lot after subdivision carries a 390 square metre minimum at 13 metres wide and 30 metres deep.
The former North Delta Area Plan identified residential infill east of 116 Street between 90 Avenue and 96 Avenue, at Annieville's east seam.
Named strata condo buildings and townhome complexes in Annieville: none confirmed on an official source.

Two Development Permit Areas shape this neighbourhood in the Delta OCP 2024, Bylaw No. 8400: ND3 covers the Annieville village on River Road, and ND1, the Fraser River Escarpment area, covers the river frontage.
The current OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), consolidated the former area plans, including the North Delta Area Plan, into a single Land Use Plan.

Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600 applies parcel by parcel; the zone ladder read for this area runs from RS1 and RD3 at 4,000 square metres down through RS6 at 390 and RS7 at 335 square metres, and there is no RD5 zone.
Small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) in Delta allows combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the bylaw applies.

blocks.text: Annieville: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Annieville Lions Park at 9150 112 Street sits beside Annieville Elementary, and the City has an Annieville Lions Park Master Plan project for it.
Annieville Elementary stands at 9240 112 Street — the school and the sample locator address are the same civic address.
River Road is both the neighbourhood's frontage street and a working route toward the Tilbury industrial lands, so truck traffic is part of a frontage lot's noise picture.
The nearest hospital is Delta Hospital at 5800 Mountain View Boulevard in Ladner, and the North Delta Public Health Unit is at 11245 84 Avenue.
Delta checks steep slopes through its Development Permit Areas, a slope policy and geotechnical requirements — the City's own checklist for lots like the escarpment frontage here.
Annieville Lions Park Master Plan, 9150 112 Street, City of Delta: status — City park master plan project (as of November 3, 2026).
The Delta-specific figure a new Annieville owner budgets: the 2026 flat-rate utility total is $1,658 for a single-family home, billed annually in late February, with metered homes billed quarterly.
Delta's 2026 Financial Plan included a 2.9 percent property tax increase for City operational services.
Route 312 connects Annieville's 112 Street corridor to Scott Road Station and Scottsdale Exchange; route 391 does the same via 116 Street.
River Road runs the Fraser River frontage west toward Tilbury and east toward Nordel Way and Highway 91 access for the Alex Fraser Bridge.
112 Street and 116 Street run south through Nordel to Nordel Way, the neighbourhood's main east–west arterial below Annieville.

Check ND1 first on any frontage lot: the OCP's Fraser River Escarpment area lists mud flows, debris flows, erosion, land slip and subsidence, and the City requires geotechnical work under its slope policy.
Confirm the parcel's Development Permit Area status and constraints on DeltaMap; the City states the map is for convenience and requirements should be confirmed with its Application Centre.
Riparian and streamside work near the river and its creeks can engage the federal Fisheries Act, the provincial Water Sustainability Act and the Riparian Areas Regulation as well as Delta's bylaws.
Read the title through the Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia: the City states title charges can affect a property's use or redevelopment.

faq.q: Which schools serve an Annieville address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. For the sample address 9240 112 Street, the School District No. The district has no middle-school tier in its locator, and east-side addresses can fall to other schools, so run the exact address.

faq.q: Is the Fraser River frontage a hazard area?
faq.a: Yes, on the frontage itself. The ND1 Fraser River Escarpment Development Permit Area covers it, and the OCP lists mud flows, debris flows, erosion, land slip and subsidence for that area, with river bank and ravine slopes subject to erosion. A geotechnical review belongs in the subject list for a River Road or slope-side lot, not after removal.

faq.q: Can a big river-side lot be subdivided?
faq.a: Sometimes, through rezoning rather than by right. Price a large parcel on its rezoning and servicing answer, not on the house alone.

faq.q: How do buses reach SkyTrain from here?
faq.a: Two routes terminate at Scott Road Station on the Expo Line. Route 312 runs via Scott Road, 96 Avenue, 114 Street, 92A Avenue, 112 Street and 72 Avenue to Scottsdale Exchange, and route 391 runs via 72 Avenue, 116 Street and 96 Avenue. The 112 Street and 116 Street legs are the Annieville-side segments of each route.

faq.q: How do buses connect Annieville to SkyTrain?
faq.a: Routes 312 and 391 both terminate at Scott Road Station on the Expo Line — the 312 runs via 112 Street and the 391 via 116 Street.
George Mackie Library, a Fraser Valley Regional Library branch, is at 8440 112th Street, Delta, just east of Annieville in Nordel.
